I had high expectations from Pinklay, given their branding and pricing. Unfortunately, my recent experience has been incredibly disappointing. I purchased a bathrobe that looked beautiful initially, but after the first wash, it shrunk significantly, the colors started to bleed beyond the design, and there were visible loose threads all over. For a premium product, this level of degradation is unacceptable.

What’s worse? Pinklay’s customer service was dismissive and unprofessional. Instead of acknowledging the defects, they blamed the product’s fabric and even suggested I should iron the bathrobe to restore its shape—ironing a bathrobe?! They also claimed the color bleeding was due to the hand block printing process. While I appreciate artisan work, this should not justify poor quality control.

Despite numerous attempts to resolve the issue, they refused to offer a refund or exchange, claiming there was no defect. This lack of accountability and refusal to stand behind their products is shocking for a brand that markets itself as premium.

I’ve loved Pinklay’s products in the past and even promoted them on social media, but after this experience, I will no longer recommend them. Beware if you’re considering buying from them—if anything goes wrong, you’re on your own.

I visited the store yesterday to look for curtains for two rooms—our guest room and store room—hence, we were on a budget. From the beginning, the salesman kept saying “inka budget nahi hai” to his colleagues, loudly and repeatedly. It was not only unprofessional, but also demeaning and subtly insulting. That’s when the real chaos began.

He claimed the material was out of stock and would arrive in 2 days. Another employee (possibly assigned to monitor him) contradicted him, saying it would take at least 4 days. Fine. When I objected, they consulted a Mr. Islam (manager or owner), who rudely dismissed the entire issue and said, “Rates can change in an hour.”

So, here’s the truth:
If a business cannot stand by its word for even 24 hours, how can I trust them to deliver my order in 2–4 days as claimed? Today it's the price. Tomorrow it’ll be the delivery. And the day after, it’ll be denial of any prior commitment.

Absolutely unprofessional, arrogant, and disrespectful conduct from the staff—especially the management. They might have a big store, but unfortunately, they lack basic courtesy and ethics. The name "NOVELTY" is ironic—they don’t even seem to understand the meaning of the word.
